faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: A landing page usually takes 1 to 2 weeks and a business website 2 to 4 weeks. Stores and custom apps depend on the features, so you get a fixed date in the written scope before we start.

faq.q: How many revisions do I get?
faq.a: Two rounds of changes at each stage are included. Since you see a live preview from week one, most changes happen early, when they're quick to make. Anything outside the agreed scope gets quoted before I do it.
50% upfront to book your slot, and the remaining 50% when the site is ready to launch. The price is fixed in the scope, so there are no surprise bills.
You do. Once the final payment is made, the code, the domain and every account are yours. I hand over the repository and all logins at launch.

I fix any bugs that show up in the first 50 days for free. After that I can help with updates when you need them, or you can give the code to any developer. It's standard React and Next.js, nothing unusual.

faq.q: You're a student. Will you have time for my project?
faq.a: Yes. I take on a small number of projects at a time so each one gets proper attention, and I tell you my availability before we start. You'll hear back within 24 hours, IST.
